avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains lovastatin (statin); additive LDL-lowering effects may cause excessive lipid reduction and potential muscle toxicity when combined with evolocumab
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative supplements or use only under physician supervision with LDL monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Plant Sterols/Stanols
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive LDL-lowering effect; may enhance therapeutic benefit but could lower LDL excessively in some patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor lipid panel; adjust dosing if LDL becomes subtherapeutic or excessively low

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild triglyceride-lowering effects; may have synergistic benefits but no major interaction
caution_supplements.action: Safe to use; monitor triglyceride levels periodically

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair subcutaneous absorption of evolocumab; clinically minor effect
caution_foods.action: Administer injections consistently; food does not significantly impact efficacy but consistency in administration timing is important

monitoring_notes: Evolocumab is a monoclonal antibody not metabolized hepatically, making it relatively free from traditional drug-nutrient interactions. Monitor LDL-C levels regularly, especially if patient concurrently uses other lipid-lowering supplements, to avoid excessive LDL reduction which may be associated with adverse effects.
